services.desc: Need a fantastic venue for a family reunion, company party, birthday party, or neighborhood get together? Our pavilions, cabanas, and rentable areas provide your family or group with great amenities, fantastic mountain views, lots of shade, and memories you will cherish forever! Time slots go fast so we suggest making a reservation early for the summer season. Book your fun today! Metal serving tables, electricity, lights, and drinking water are available at each pavilion. services.name: Miniature Golf
services.desc: Come play one of the most challenging miniature golf courses in Utah. With an updated look and some new features, this golf course is one of a kind. Each hole has a theme such as castles, windmills, ski mountains, and more. Grab a date or bring the family for some wholesome fun! During Scary Hill the Mini Golf is re-themed with favorite Halloween characters like Dracula, Witches, Spiders, etc… Pumpkins are lit around the golf along with festive music and Halloween décor. blurb: Cherry Hill has 120 beautiful campsites nestled among hundreds of trees. The majority of our sites are Full Hook up RV sites with 30 amp electricity, we also have some Full Hook Up sites with 50 amp electricity available for larger RV’s. No Hook up Tent Sites and Tent Sites with 20 amp electric hook ups are also available during our summer season. We accommodate tents and all RV’s up to 40 feet in length.
